statement.text: The overfull parameter is defined as follows: $$ w(G) = \max_{H \subseteq G} \left\lceil \frac{ |E(H)| }{ \lfloor \tfrac{1}{2} |V(H)| \rfloor} \right\rceil. $$ Conjecture Every graph $G$ satisfies $\chi'(G) \le \max\{ \Delta(G) + 1, w(G) \}$.

title: Goldberg's conjecture
